heading: Construction
text:
### Construction [LTSL.4.1]

In `initial`, `inputs`, and `responses` replies a fact is **constructed** in
emit-style: the schema name followed by colon-keyword slot values, with all
author-supplied slots given (`TempReading zone: "cellar" celsius: 2.0`). A
`responses` reply may leave out its `corr`, which the test runner then supplies
([LTSL.7.2]). A
constructed fact's slot values must be literals; the compiler lowers them to
literal slot values (`TestFact` / `TestReply` / `TestCacheSeed`, [RLOW.17.2]).

A literal is an `Int` or `Float` literal, optionally negated; a duration
literal; a `Bool`; a `String` with no interpolation site; or `json("…")` over
one string literal ([LGRA.9.8.3]). A `json()` argument's escapes are decoded
and its braces are literal text, not an interpolation site. Its text must be a
JSON value, and the test runner must refuse a scenario whose `json()` text does
not parse as one. The name of a `const` ([LGRA.4]) is admitted wherever a
literal is when its folded value is of a kind a literal writes: an `Int` or a
`Float`, a quantity's stored number among them ([LUNI.7.6]), a duration, a
`Bool`, a `String` or a `Json` value. The compiler folds it to that value. A
`const` of any other kind, a `Time` or a `Date` among them, is not admitted. The
compiler must refuse any other value with `DS_VALIDATE_TEST_NON_LITERAL`.
